components.explanation: The scoot clip: the two-cell sheet packed from Kiran's A2 CHAR-SCOOT-A/B art (with its import settings, attribution and packing tool), scoot.tres (one discrete frame track, LOOP_LINEAR) and the scoot preview fixture.

The land clip: land.tres (three continuous rig tracks, keys at 0, 2, 4 and 8 frames, LOOP_NONE), the CHAR-IDLE.png drawing the two slices are cut from, and the land preview fixture used for strips r0 and r1.
player_visuals.tscn: the scoot sprite slicing the sheet, the two-piece rig, and one AnimationPlayer on the physics callback with one embedded library.
player.gd's appended visual layer (_update_visuals, _clip_time): pose to clip, facing and visibility writes, playback requests, the pause rule and the Revision 2 hand-off seek.
The A7 read-backs, pins, structure, per-tick state and edge tests, and the supplemental entry-order probe.

centered = false

hframes = 2
vframes = 1
frame = 0

loop_mode = 1
step = 0.016666668
tracks/0/type = "value"
tracks/0/imported = false
tracks/0/enabled = true
tracks/0/path = NodePath("FacingPivot/Scoot/ScootSprite:frame")
tracks/0/interp = 1
tracks/0/loop_wrap = true
tracks/0/keys = {
"times": PackedFloat32Array(0, 0.11666667),
"transitions": PackedFloat32Array(1, 1),
"update": 1,

check("no RESET animation", not player.has_animation(&"RESET"), str(player.get_animation_list()))
	check("clip scoot exists", player.has_animation(&"scoot"), str(player.get_animation_list()))
	check("clip land exists", player.has_animation(&"land"), str(player.get_animation_list()))
	var problems := track_problems(player)
	for p in problems:
		print("  track problem: " + p)
	check("every track of every clip resolves (track_problems)", problems.is_empty(), "%d problems over clips %s" % [problems.size(), player.get_animation_list()])

anim = visuals.get_node("AnimationPlayer")
	facing_pivot.transform = Transform2D(Vector2(facing, 0), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2.ZERO)
	var want: StringName = POSE_CLIPS.get(pose, &"")
	scoot_node.visible = want == &"scoot"
	land_rig.visible = want == &"land"
	sprite.visible = want == &""
	if want == &"":
		# Leaving a clip (hop, walk-off, override, tick-8 hand-off, reset): stop it.
		if clip != &"":
			anim.stop()
		clip = &""
		clip_held = false
		return

[node name="AnimationPlayer" type="AnimationPlayer" parent="."]
root_node = NodePath("..")
libraries = {
&"": SubResource("AnimationLibrary_visuals")
}
callback_mode_process = 0
autoplay = &""

anim.play(want)
	if clip == &"land" and want == &"scoot" and not clip_held:
		# Direct LAND -> SCOOT switch: the AnimationPlayer was already playing land, and its own update
		# later this tick adds 1/60 (fd4d855). Seek one tick earlier on the loop so it lands on the synced time
		# (probe H3, prompt-5e).
		anim.seek(fposmod(_clip_time(want) - 1.0 / CLIP_FPS, anim.get_animation(&"scoot").length), true)
	else:
		anim.seek(_clip_time(want), true)
	clip = want
	clip_held = false

code_result_pairs.observation: Kiran's committed CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png, 2048 × 1024, divided at x 1024 (hframes 2, vframes 1): cell 0 is CHAR-SCOOT-A, cell 1 CHAR-SCOOT-B; the packing tool's 0-mismatch result is quoted from ATTRIBUTION.md.

Scoot fixture strip r1: facing right, frame 259 clip t=0.1 cell 0, frame 260 t=0.116667 cell 1 (the swap), frame 261 cell 1; facing left at wrap 1, frame 322 t=0.216667 cell 1, frame 323 t=0 cell 0 (scoot.log).
M1 diff renames UpperPivot:position to positon; the mutated land read-back prints the track problem and ends 94 checks / 3 failures; the committed log ends 135 checks / 0 failures.

In the scripted capture, the stationary hop lands at tick 293; the rig is the only visible visual with clip land at (8 − land_ticks)/60 on ticks 293–300 and the original sprite from 301; scooting shows the scoot sprite with the cell swapping at tick % 14 = 7 and the facing mirrored when the direction changes.

In the scripted capture, jump presses read at touchdown +1, +3 and +6 (touchdowns 652, 786, 922) give ANTIC on ticks 653, 789 and 928, with LAND and the rig on every earlier tick from touchdown; 859 per-tick checks, 0 failures over the take.

Lines quoted in TEST-REPORT.md from the 74fe4b5 state-test log show diff_ticks=1.000000 after the LAND → SCOOT switch; lines 4468–4469 of the committed 60 fps log show diff_ticks 0 and cell 0 on both SCOOT-A ticks.

In the scripted capture the jelly lands moving at tick 521; LAND on 521–528, SCOOT-B from 529 with clip scoot at (tick % 14)/60 = 9/60 s, cell 1; every SCOOT tick matched the synced time within 1e-6 s.
Land fixture strips r0 (frames 104–109) and r1 (145–150): FALL, rig 0, rig 2, rig 4, rig 6 and the IDLE hand-off at tick 8; Kiran's r0 verdict quoted from TUNING.md.
